title: A knowledge field on items: questions and stable kb references
goal: Items may carry knowledge: {ask: [questions], refs: [topic ids, QK answer ids, source ids, <root>/<path>#<fact key>]}; backlog.py check rejects a reference that does not exist in the kb at HEAD, and a fact key no longer found (a reworded or removed fact) is reported as stale knowledge.
notes: Fact keys are kbfacts.fact_key (12 hex), the same keys _anchors.csv and doc2query use; line numbers are never stored.
